name: Global Summation of Bounded Local Terms
description: Replaces a local requirement (every edge must have property X) with a global requirement (the sum of a function over all edges must equal M). By choosing a function that is strictly bounded by 1 given the variable domain, the global sum can only reach M if every single edge maximizes the function. This forces the LLM to mathematically deduce the local constraint from the global bound, preventing simple surface-level pattern matching to graph coloring.
